fusions.name: Hatching Ground
fusions.desc: Hoppers erupt from the soil around you, dealing 14 earth damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and stunning them for 1 second. You heal for 15% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Clod Burst
fusions.desc: Hurls a clod that deals 30 earth damage to the first enemy it meets, then bursts, hitting every enemy within 3 tiles for 80% of that. Your afflictions on the target spread to every enemy within 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Buried Egg Bed
fusions.desc: Buries an egg bed for 10 seconds. Hoppers hatch from it and bite an enemy within 4 tiles for 3 damage every second, each bite with a 30% chance to leave the target [Slowed] for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Stone-Chewing Jaws
fusions.desc: Your earth damage cannot be resisted, and your other abilities come round 5% sooner.
